subject: CAIQ response: control tailoring & evidence protocol for Oceanic Health
messages:
From: Rachel Smythe <rachel.smythe@oceanichealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Oceanic Health Audit Team <audit@oceanichealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ questionnaire: request and scope clarifications

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for taking this on. I've attached Oceanic Health's CAIQ (v4) spreadsheet with our clarifying questions and a handful of control tailoring asks — we're trying to limit the scope to the managed inference surface (hosted + dedicated) and exclude customer-managed private deployments unless contractually required.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood provide per-control rationales where you expect a customer assertion vs Redwood responsibility?
- For controls referencing key management and HSM, can you confirm which are mapped to Private deployments only vs Hosted/Dedicated?
- We need example evidence IDs/filenames for runtime telemetry and log sampling (small extracts are fine).

Would you be able to return a marked-up CAIQ with the mapping table and a brief evidence protocol by next Wednesday (2028-06-07)? Attachments: Oceanic_CAIQ_Questions_20280604.xlsx

Thanks,
Rachel
Security Assurance Manager
Oceanic Health

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Smythe <rachel.smythe@oceanichealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ questionnaire: request and scope clarifications

Hi Rachel — thanks for the clear asks and the spreadsheet. I've looped in Irene (security/compliance) and Kimberly (runtime telemetry owner) to help with detailed mapping and evidence.

Plan:
1) Kimberly will put together a control-by-control matrix that separates Redwood responsibilities (hosted + dedicated) from customer responsibilities (private deploy / customer-managed keys).
2) Irene will extract example evidence artifacts (log sample filenames, telemetry extract IDs, and retention statements).
3) I'll reconcile the tailored controls and prepare a short protocol document describing how we provide evidence and our redaction rules.

We'll target a draft matrix and evidence package by 2028-06-06 EOD PST so you have time to review before your deadline.

Quick clarifications for our team: are you treating CAIQ controls that reference "key custody" as in-scope only when customer selects Private deployment (i.e., Redwood-hosted KMS remains Redwood responsibility)? If so we'll mark those as customer-responsibility when Private is chosen.

—Lukas
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Smythe <rachel.smythe@oceanichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ questionnaire: control mapping draft and evidence index (DRAFT)

Forwarding draft mapping — see attached CAIQ-control-mapping-draft-20280605.xlsx (tabbed: control_mapping, evidence_index, tailoring_notes). Highlights below:

- Control ownership: Split column (Redwood vs Customer). Most dataflow/run-time controls are Redwood-owned for Hosted/Dedicated (e.g., CCM-6.2 accept/deny rules, telemetry collection). Key-rotation & HSM controls default to Customer for Private deploys.
- Evidence naming: runtime logs use standardized IDs: rwd-telemetry-YYYYMMDD-sample.log (we included two 7-line extracts in the evidence_index and one cleaned audit trail).
- Tailoring: For controls that rely on tenant isolation, we've added a short note linking to the tenancy design doc and proposed assertion language.
- Attachments: I included a redaction checklist (sensitive PII removal) and recommended sampling window (48-hour contiguous window + one-week aggregate snapshot).

Outstanding for verification:
1) Irene to confirm retention SLA language and exact S3 path patterns for log extracts we reference.
2) Lukas to sign off on tailoring notes and the final assertion phrasing for the CAIQ.

Kimberly
Director, Observability & Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: CAIQ-control-mapping-draft-20280605.xlsx (3 tabs), runtime-log-sample-rwd-telemetry-20280530.log (redacted sample)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Smythe <rachel.smythe@oceanichealth.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ questionnaire: control tailoring & evidence protocol for Oceanic Health — FINAL delivery

Hi Rachel — attaching our final response package per your format (we uploaded native spreadsheet to the Drive link and included evidence stubs). Deliverables:
- Completed CAIQ (answers column populated, assertions tailored for Hosted + Dedicated scope).
- Control mapping: per-control responsibility and short rationale (Redwood vs Customer).
- Evidence index: sample filenames and access instructions for the artifacts we can share.
- Evidence protocol (short doc inside the Drive): sampling windows, redaction policy, and verifier access steps.

Notes & exceptions:
- Key custody: For private deployments where customers hold keys in their KMS/HSM, we marked KMS-related controls as Customer responsibility; we provided sample attestations for Redwood-managed KMS for hosted/dedicated.
- Telemetry extracts: provided three 7-line redacted samples (runtime-log-sample-*) and a hash manifest.
- Timing: For deeper auditor access (live traces or larger log windows), we requested a joint scoped access window; please let us know your auditor's contact to arrange and sign the access Annex.

Next steps: Rachel, can you confirm receipt and let us know if you want the finalized CAIQ returned as a CSV? Also confirm whether you prefer our assertion phrasing for tenant isolation or if you'd like alternate language.

Thanks — Irene (on behalf of Lukas, Kimberly, and the security team)
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Oceanic_CAIQ_Questions_20280604.xlsx (original), CAIQ-control-mapping-draft-20280605.xlsx (finalized), runtime-log-sample-rwd-20280530.log (redacted), evidence-manifest-hashes.txt
